senses.gloss: שֵׁרֵת (b. h.; [to dwell with,] to serve, minister, attend.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:4">Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 3:1">I Sam. III, 1</cite>) <he>והלא לא מְשָׁרֵת אלא לפני עלי</he> but did not he minister before Eli only? <he>ללמדך שכל שירות שש׳ וכ׳</he> to teach thee that all the ministrations that he rendered to Eli were accounted to him as if he had ministered before the Lord; (Midr. Sam. ch. VIII <he>היה עומד</he>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:8">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>הושע</he> … <he>משרת תחתיך</he> Hoshea … shall serve in thy stead; a. e.
